_comment: VERIFY against current OpenCode config docs (schema drifts). Copy to ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json (global) or <project>/.opencode/opencode.json and fill in REAL values there — that copy is NOT committed and is where your server IP / NFS model path live. Points OpenCode's build engine DIRECTLY at your OpenAI-compatible endpoint (NO proxy). Provider key ('vllm_api') must equal OPENCODE_PROVIDER_ID in .env; the model key must equal HARNESS_MODEL (vLLM served ids are often a full path with a LEADING SLASH — use it exactly). The 'permission' block: edit=allow (the agent's only job), bash=DENY and webfetch=DENY because OpenCode's bash runs on the SERVE HOST not the sandbox — the harness runs ALL tests/installs in the container, so the agent must never execute. 'deny' also means no interactive prompt (so the headless server doesn't block). VERIFY the permission keys/values against your OpenCode version.
